body.statement: Uniformly over \(P\in\mathcal P_{\kappa}\), \(P(\mathcal E_{\kappa})\to1\), \(\sqrt n\{\widehat\theta-\theta\}=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^nG_p(O_i)+o_P(1)\), and \(\widehat\Sigma-\Sigma(p)=o_P(1)\). Moreover, allowing \(\Sigma(p)\) to be singular while retaining its buffered reported diagonal, \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_{\kappa}}P(\theta_\ell\in I_{\ell,n}\text{ for every }\ell\in\mathcal L)\to1-\alpha\).
body.justification: The coverage theorem integrates data-dependent numerical guards with a singular-correlation Gaussian maximum, the unresolved proof boundary left by pointwise interior theory.
body.gap: Chernozhukov, Chetverikov, and Kato allow arbitrary Gaussian correlation under positive marginal variances, but do not study a guarded rational spectral map; Ahn and Kasahara's weighted-bootstrap intervals do not establish uniform acceptance and coverage on an absorbing face.
body.consumer: Users can report joint bands for all type-specific and aggregate state effects even when adding-up identities make the nine-dimensional covariance singular.
